page.content:
The QUATRO Figure is a type of minifigure larger than a DUPLO Figure made from a single piece. There was only one QUATRO figure released in the one set, 5470 My First QUATRO Figure.

page.overview:
Who is QUATRO Figure?

The QUATRO Figure is a type of minifigure larger than a DUPLO Figure made from a single piece. There was only one QUATRO figure released in the one set, 5470 My First QUATRO Figure.
